title: Rarity and grades
text: Items climb the seven Tensura grades, lowest to highest: Normal (grey), Special (green), Rare (aqua), Unique (pink), Legend (gold), God (red), Genesis (white). Above them stands EX-Singularity, which is never dropped, only handed out. Weapon damage by grade: Normal 20-30, Special 35-55, Rare 60-85, Unique 90-115, Legend 130-175, God 190-240, Genesis 260-350, EX-Singularity 420-560. Loot weight (higher is commoner): Normal 40, Special 28, Rare 16, Unique 8, Legend 4, God 1.5, Genesis 0.5. Worn relics add existence points: Rare +0.5%, Unique +1%, Legend +2.5%, God +6%, Genesis +12% (25% in total). Only Legend and above can carry a Djinn. Where to find them: overworld chests of ancient cities, bastions, trial chambers and vaults have a 5% chance of a Rare to Legend relic; strongholds 4% (Special to Unique); dungeons 3% (Normal to Unique). In the Mega-Dungeon, chests in hidden rooms have a 30% chance of a Normal to Rare relic, and Unique and above come only from the Crucible of Choice (one pick per region). Every relic is one of a kind in the world (the God of Order keeps the ledger). Beast and Mana Core ranks use the same colours: C is Special, B Rare, A Unique, S Legend, SS God. Devils: Low Rare, Mid Unique, High Legend, Supreme God.
